I prepared Northfield payment PAY-90412 for $18,500 and left it unreleased.

Payments over $10,000 need a second-person approval, so I cannot release it on your instruction alone. Hannah Cole is unavailable until 19:00. Victor Osei and Grace Kim are available, so I asked Victor to approve or decline. I will release it only after one of them approves.
